findings.explanation: transfer debits the source before checking available funds. Transferring 51 cents from a 50-cent balance raises InsufficientFunds but leaves the source at -1, violating error atomicity. Check funds before changing either balance.

test_insufficient_funds_changes_nothing only checks the exception, so it passes despite the corrupted source balance. Assert both balances remain unchanged after errors. Also cover a negative amount alongside zero.
